timeout_assignment_note: Per-attempt numeric override fields take precedence; otherwise the frozen manifest timeout is used. Policy mentions are retained and flagged, never silently assigned to attempts.

interpretation.wall_time: Sum of per-attempt wall_seconds, including failed attempts and setup/cleanup; concurrent request durations overlap, so this is not elapsed batch wall-clock time.
interpretation.tokens: known_sum contains reported token counts only. missing_records are never filled with zero; these totals do not establish complete billable token usage.
interpretation.scope: Only this frozen formal experiment is included. Archived smoke runs or previous experiments are excluded.
interpretation.deadline: The normal formal timeout is frozen in the manifest. Different deadline layers, if any, must be presented separately.
